Name: PinkStations Hilltop Farm Map
Author: PinkStations
Description:
[left][size=2][size=4][b]~PinkStations Hilltop Farm~[/b][/size]
My prettier and organized hilltop farm map. It has a heart shaped quarry & beehive area, 3 waterfalls, designated spaces for farm animals (they cannot pass over the bridge), Designated areas for all your buildings, and a beautiful spot in the middle for your gold clock! I've added a labeled picture to show where everything is ideally placed.

If you love this map but want to freestyle it yourself there's also a clean version. Do whatever you'd like and feel free to share a screenshot! I'd love to see what you can do with it!

You can change the farm layout (Decorated or Clean) from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or changing directly in the config file!
